description: This file is an API client module for a fruit shop frontend application. It manages environment variable retrieval, mock product data, and functions to fetch product lists, individual products, and submit checkout orders, with fallback mechanisms to mock data if backend API calls fail or environment variables are missing.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables in React environment, with optional fallback.

methods.name: fetchProducts
methods.description: Fetches list of products from backend API or returns mock data on failure.

methods.name: fetchProductById
methods.description: Fetches a single product by ID from backend API or returns mock data if API fails.

methods.name: submitCheckout
methods.description: Submits an order payload to backend checkout endpoint or returns a mock confirmation if API fails.
